command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== baseline: module loaded? =="
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "not currently loaded"

echo "== step 1: blacklist conf =="
printf 'blacklist usb-storage\ninstall usb-storage /bin/true\n' | sudo tee /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf

echo "== step 2: remove module if loaded =="
sudo modprobe -r usb_storage 2>&1 || echo "modprobe -r: not loaded or removal not needed"

echo "== step 3: update initramfs so blacklist applies at boot =="
if command -v update-initramfs >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo update-initramfs -u
elif command -v dracut >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo dracut -f
else
  echo "no initramfs tool found"
fi

echo "== verify: modprobe config =="
cat /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf

echo "== verify: currently loaded modules =="
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "confirmed: usb_storage not loaded"

echo "== verify: modprobe -n -v simulated load =="
sudo modprobe -n -v usb_storage || true
